title: Deployment Shape and Operating Model
summary: This intermediate module enables a learner to identify why the requested source correction is blocked and determine which evidence is needed before making a safe, minimal update.
objectives: Identify the missing evidence needed to determine which cited source changed and what content that change affected.
Explain why the current module is required to preserve unaffected material during a correction.
Distinguish a verified source correction from an unsupported rewrite.

sections.title: Correction status
paragraphs: This is an intermediate-level review of a blocked correction. The changed cited source is UNKNOWN. The supplied record identifies only the internal path content/modules/self-hosted-model-operations/deployment-shape-and-operating-model.json, labels its publisher as unregistered, and says it was never verified. It does not provide an old source URL, a replacement URL, or a documented source-change event.

What the source change affected is also UNKNOWN. The existing objectives, sections, knowledge checks, source records, and verification metadata were not supplied, so no affected claim or answer can be identified without guessing.
sections.callout: Do not treat an unavailable baseline as permission to replace the module. Obtain the existing file and source history before applying the correction.

sections.title: Requirements for a minimal update
paragraphs: A minimal correction requires the verbatim current module as its baseline. The old and replacement source records are also required to determine whether a URL moved, a source passed its review cadence, or its contents changed. Comparing those records reveals which claims require correction and which material must remain unchanged.

Preservation of unaffected material is UNKNOWN because the current module was not supplied. Catalogue-wide uniqueness of the module identifier and question identifiers is also UNKNOWN because no catalogue registry was supplied. These facts must be established before committing an update.

sections.title: Subject scope
paragraphs: The intended meanings of deployment shape, operating model, and self-hosted model operations are UNKNOWN in the supplied material. No technical definition, architecture, operational practice, product, deployment mechanism, or configuration detail can be added responsibly until the existing module and its authoritative references are available.

After completing this module, a learner can recognize that the requested correction lacks the evidence needed to update technical content without rewriting it. The appropriate next step is to obtain the exact existing file, its source history, the prior source record, and the replacement or newly reviewed source.

sections.title: Serialization requirement
paragraphs: The deliverable must be one valid JSON object. JSON represents structured values using objects, arrays, numbers, strings, booleans, and null. Correct delimiters, escaping, and value syntax are required for a conforming JSON text.

JSON.parse returns the value represented by conforming JSON text and throws a SyntaxError when the text does not conform to JSON grammar. This parsing requirement does not establish whether the module is a minimal correction; that determination still requires the missing baseline.

questions.prompt: What does the supplied material establish about which cited source changed?
choices: It identifies both the old URL and its replacement.
It establishes that the source contents changed but not where they moved.
The changed cited source is UNKNOWN because no old URL, replacement URL, or documented change event was supplied.
It establishes that no source review is required.
questions.explanation: The module states that only an internal path and an unverified status were supplied. Those details do not identify a moved or changed cited source.

questions.prompt: Which missing input is necessary to establish that unaffected module material was preserved?
choices: The exact current module file used as the baseline
A newly invented definition of deployment shape
questions.explanation: The exact current module is required for comparison. Without that baseline, preservation and minimality cannot be demonstrated.

questions.prompt: What should happen before technical subject matter is corrected?
choices: Technical definitions should be inferred from the filename.
The module should be rewritten without consulting its previous content.
The existing module, source history, and relevant authoritative references should be obtained.
All existing material should be deleted.
questions.explanation: The module explains that its technical scope is UNKNOWN and that the existing content and authoritative references are required before a supported correction can be made.
